## Design

### 2026-10-06 – October 6th - Making the PCB

**2h**

October 6th - Making the PCB

Today I designed the PCB. This was my second time working with kicad so I knew at least a little bit what I was doing. I followed the Starbie tutorial but I tried to make to design original. Tommorow I might add some pictures and improve the shape of the PCB.

### 2026-10-08 – October 8th - Working on Starbie

**4h**

October 8th - Working on Starbie
Today I continued working on my Starbie. First I improved the PCB and made the corners rounded. Then I started to make the firmware. I wrote the code included in the week 1 guide and customised it to be original. I added my own star shaped trail and played with some values in the code. After that I made a cat pixel art as the pet.

### 2026-10-11 – October 11th - Finishing starbie

**5h**

October 11th - Finishing starbie
Today I added a new function to my starbie. Now it shows a snowflake or a sweat drop depending on the temperature. Then I exported the gerber files, organized everythinginto folders, pushed it all to github and wrote a README.
